description: SpellVisualEvent.StartEvent -> where in a spell's life a visual kit starts. Shipped as the phase word on every row that happens at a moment: a kit's payloads carry the event that started them, a missile starts the travel, an effect lands at the cast or the impact, and an aura holds from its start. The names are WoWDBDefs' SpellVisualEventEvent.dbde, spelled as one search word each; an end is its own word because kits do start at ends. Values 14 to 24 exist in the enum unnamed and are rare in the data; they are listed as the empty word so a row storing one indexes a real entry that reads as no word. Value 25 is the pack's own: the server's launch, after the cast and before the travel, which the client never names; the effects the server only runs at launch sit there whatever the spell's speed.
